acme's payout is recorded. The refunds still match W2's report, so I'll record birch's payout of 28695 next.

The refunds still match W2's report, and the net balances check out against the orders: birch is 32699 minus 4004 refunded, which is 28695. Cobalt is 30927 minus 1660, which is 29267. Acme has no refunds. Next I'll record cobalt's payout of 29267.
